/**
 * ProfessionalChart React component instance
 * This is the raw React component instance passed to the onReady callback
 * and returned by chartWrapper.getChartInstance()
 */
export type ChartInstance = {
	/**
	 * Destroy the chart and clean up all resources
	 */
	destroy(): void;

	/**
	 * Set broker account data for trading features
	 * @param data - Broker account data including accounts, orders, trades, and positions
	 */
	setBrokerAccounts(data: BrokerAccountData): void;

	/**
	 * Update existing positions without a full setBrokerAccounts rebuild.
	 * Merges partial updates into positions matched by `key`.
	 * Useful for updating dynamic fields like pnlMultiplier, bid, ask, ltp
	 * that change frequently (e.g. cross-currency conversion rates).
	 * @param positions - Array of partial position updates (must include `key`)
	 */
	updatePositions(positions: Array<Partial<Position> & Pick<Position, 'key'>>): void;

	/**
	 * Change the symbol
	 * @param newSymbol - New symbol to display
	 */
	setSymbol(newSymbol: string): void;

	/**
	 * Change the interval
	 * @param newInterval - New time interval
	 */
	setInterval(newInterval: string): void;

	/**
	 * Change the theme
	 * @param newTheme - The theme to apply ('light' or 'dark')
	 */
	setTheme(newTheme: "light" | "dark"): void;

	/**
	 * Resize the chart
	 * @param width - New width
	 * @param height - New height
	 */
	resize(width: number | string, height: number | string): void;

	/**
	 * Change symbol of a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param newSymbol - New symbol to display
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to change (0-based)
	 */
	setChartSymbolAtIndex(newSymbol: string, chartIdx: number): void;

	/**
	 * Change interval of a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param newInterval - New interval to display
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to change (0-based)
	 */
	setIntervalAtIndex(newInterval: string, chartIdx: number): void;

	/**
	 * Add an indicator to the currently selected chart
	 * @param indicator - Indicator object with type and id properties
	 */
	addIndicator(indicator: { type?: string; id?: string }): void;

	/**
	 * Add an indicator to a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param indicator - Indicator object with type and id properties
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to add indicator to (0-based)
	 */
	addIndicatorAtIndex(
		indicator: { type?: string; id?: string },
		chartIdx: number,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Add a drawing to the currently selected chart
	 * @param drawing - Drawing object with type/name, options, and appearance properties
	 * @param chartId - Chart ID to add the drawing to (default: "MAIN_CHART")
	 */
	addDrawing(
		drawing: {
			type?: string;
			name?: string;
			options?: DrawingOptions;
			appearance?: DrawingAppearance;
		},
		chartId?: string,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Add a drawing to a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param drawing - Drawing object with type/name, options, and appearance properties
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to add drawing to (0-based)
	 * @param chartId - Chart ID to add the drawing to (default: "MAIN_CHART")
	 */
	addDrawingAtIndex(
		drawing: {
			type?: string;
			name?: string;
			options?: DrawingOptions;
			appearance?: DrawingAppearance;
		},
		chartIdx: number,
		chartId?: string,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Delete an object (drawing or indicator) from the currently selected chart
	 * @param objectId - ID of the object to delete
	 * @param chartId - Chart ID to delete the object from (default: "MAIN_CHART")
	 */
	deleteObject(objectId: string, chartId?: string): void;

	/**
	 * Delete an object (drawing or indicator) from a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param objectId - ID of the object to delete
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to delete object from (0-based)
	 * @param chartId - Chart ID to delete the object from (default: "MAIN_CHART")
	 */
	deleteObjectAtIndex(
		objectId: string,
		chartIdx: number,
		chartId?: string,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Update chart settings for the currently selected chart
	 * @param settings - Settings object to update (e.g., { timezone: "America/New_York", showGrid: true })
	 * @example
	 * chart.updateSettings({ timezone: "America/New_York", showGrid: true });
	 */
	updateSettings(settings: Partial<ChartSettings>): void;

	/**
	 * Update chart settings for a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param settings - Settings object to update (e.g., { timezone: "America/New_York", showGrid: true })
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to update settings for (0-based)
	 * @example
	 * chart.updateSettingsAtIndex({ timezone: "America/New_York", showGrid: true }, 0);
	 */
	updateSettingsAtIndex(
		settings: Partial<ChartSettings>,
		chartIdx: number,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Get the complete chart state for the currently selected chart
	 * @returns The complete chart state object, or null if chart is not available
	 * @example
	 * const state = chart.getChartState();
	 * console.log(state.config.settings);
	 */
	getChartState(): ChartState | null;

	/**
	 * Get the complete chart state for a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to get state from (0-based)
	 * @returns The complete chart state object, or null if chart is not available
	 * @example
	 * const state = chart.getChartStateAtIndex(0);
	 * console.log(state.config.settings);
	 */
	getChartStateAtIndex(chartIdx: number): ChartState | null;

	/**
	 * Set the complete chart state for the currently selected chart
	 * @param newState - The new chart state object to set
	 * @example
	 * const state = chart.getChartState();
	 * state.config.settings.showGrid = true;
	 * chart.setChartState(state);
	 */
	setChartState(newState: ChartState): void;

	/**
	 * Set the complete chart state for a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param newState - The new chart state object to set
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to set state for (0-based)
	 * @example
	 * const state = chart.getChartStateAtIndex(0);
	 * state.config.settings.showGrid = true;
	 * chart.setChartStateAtIndex(state, 0);
	 */
	setChartStateAtIndex(newState: ChartState, chartIdx: number): void;

	/**
	 * Resubscribe to all active subscriptions after reconnection.
	 * This handles: candles (OHLCV), realtime ticks, compare symbols, and LIPI indicators.
	 *
	 * **Use Cases:**
	 * 1. **Browser Tab Reactivation**: When a browser tab is inactive for a long time,
	 *    Chrome and other browsers deprioritize it to save resources. This causes WebSocket
	 *    throughput to slow down significantly - instead of receiving 100 ticks, only 1 tick
	 *    may arrive, resulting in incorrectly formed candles (wrong OHLC values). When the
	 *    tab becomes active again, call this method to rehydrate the charts with fresh data.
	 *
	 * 2. **WebSocket Reconnection**: After a network disconnection or WebSocket reconnection,
	 *    use this to re-establish all data subscriptions.
	 *
	 * 3. **Authentication Token Refresh**: When the auth token is refreshed, call this with
	 *    the new token to resubscribe with updated credentials.
	 *
	 * @param idToken - Optional authentication token for resubscription
	 *
	 * @example
	 * // Listen for tab visibility changes and resubscribe when tab becomes active
	 * document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
	 *   if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
	 *     chart.resubscribeAll();
	 *   }
	 * });
	 *
	 * @example
	 * // Call after WebSocket reconnection
	 * chart.resubscribeAll();
	 *
	 * @example
	 * // Call with new auth token
	 * chart.resubscribeAll("new-auth-token");
	 */
	resubscribeAll(idToken?: string): void;

	/**
	 * Get all charts and multicharting status
	 * @returns An object containing:
	 *   - isMultichartingEnabled: boolean indicating if multicharting is enabled
	 *   - charts: array of ChartSelectedMessage objects for each chart
	 *
	 * @example
	 * const result = chart.getAllCharts();
	 * console.log(result.isMultichartingEnabled); // true if layout is not "1"
	 * console.log(result.charts); // Array of chart details
	 * // [
	 * //   { id: "MAIN_CHART", chartId: "MAIN_CHART", idx: 0, symbol: "BTCUSDT", interval: "1D" },
	 * //   { id: "CHART_2", chartId: "CHART_2", idx: 1, symbol: "ETHUSDT", interval: "1H" }
	 * // ]
	 */
	getAllCharts(): MultiChartInfo;
};

/**
 * Chart wrapper instance returned by createChart()
 * This is the wrapper object with lifecycle management methods
 */
export type ChartWrapper = {
	/**
	 * Destroy the chart and clean up all resources
	 */
	destroy(): void;

	/**
	 * Check if chart is destroyed
	 * @returns true if chart has been destroyed
	 */
	isDestroyed(): boolean;

	/**
	 * Get the underlying ProfessionalChart React component instance
	 * @returns The internal chart component instance
	 */
	getChartInstance(): ChartInstance | null;

	/**
	 * Chart API for the currently selected chart (TV `widget.activeChart()`).
	 */
	activeChart(): IChartApi;

	/**
	 * Chart API for a chart by index (TV `widget.chart(index)`).
	 */
	chart(index: number): IChartApi;

	/**
	 * Number of charts in the current layout.
	 */
	chartsCount(): number;

	/**
	 * Currently selected chart index (0-based).
	 */
	activeChartIndex(): number;

	/**
	 * Select the active chart by index.
	 * Emits `activeChartChanged` / `CHART_SELECTED`.
	 */
	setActiveChart(index: number): void;

	/**
	 * Current multi-chart layout id (GoCharting string, e.g. `"1"`, `"1|1"`, `"2|2"`).
	 */
	layout(): string;

	/**
	 * Switch multi-chart layout. Accepts GoCharting ids or mapped TV aliases
	 * (`s`, `2h`, `2v`, …). Emits `layout` / `CHART_MODE_CHANGED`.
	 */
	setLayout(layout: string): void;

	/**
	 * Set multi-chart pane sizes as row/column percentages (P2-2).
	 * Persists like drag-resize. `disableUndo` accepted for TV parity, ignored.
	 */
	setLayoutSizes(sizes: LayoutSizes, disableUndo?: boolean): void;

	/**
	 * Reset pane sizes to equal splits (P2-2). `disableUndo` ignored (TV parity).
	 */
	resetLayoutSizes(disableUndo?: boolean): void;

	/**
	 * Dispose non-visible charts soft-stashed after a layout shrink (P2-6).
	 * Prefer calling right after `setLayout` when shrinking (TV unloadUnusedCharts).
	 * Also clears chart event observers beyond `chartsCount()` and flushes
	 * sessionStorage CompleteChartLayout to the visible layout.
	 */
	unloadUnusedCharts(): void;

	/**
	 * Deep-merge chart appearance on all live charts (P3-1 / TV `applyOverrides`).
	 * GoCharting nested objects (not TV dotted paths), e.g.
	 * `{ background: { backgroundColor: "#1a1a2e" } }` or `{ appearance: { ... } }`.
	 */
	applyOverrides(overrides: ApplyOverridesInput): void;

	/**
	 * Merge study appearance/options by indicator type (P3-1).
	 * Updates matching live SERIES objects and root `objectTemplates`.
	 */
	applyStudiesOverrides(overrides: StudiesOverridesMap): void;

	/**
	 * Deep-merge root `trading` prefs (P3-1 / TV `applyTradingCustomization`).
	 */
	applyTradingCustomization(overrides: TradingCustomization): void;

	/**
	 * Set a CSS custom property on the chart container (P3-2).
	 * Name must start with `--`. Does not retheme canvas — use `setTheme` / `applyOverrides`.
	 */
	setCSSCustomProperty(name: string, value: string): void;

	/** Read a CSS custom property from the chart container (P3-2). */
	getCSSCustomPropertyValue(name: string): string;

	/** Inject a stylesheet `<link>` (idempotent by URL). Removed on destroy (P3-2). */
	addCustomCSSFile(url: string): void;

	/**
	 * Custom themes API (P3-2). Resolves with apply/reset helpers that set CSS vars
	 * on the chart container.
	 */
	customThemes(): Promise<ICustomThemesApi>;

	/**
	 * Runtime chrome features (P3-3). GC ids (`topBar`, `symbolSearch`, …);
	 * construct-time string featuresets remain Phase 4.
	 */
	features(): IFeaturesApi;

	/** Enable/disable one feature by GC id or TV alias (`header_widget`, …). */
	setFeatureEnabled(id: ChartFeatureId | string, enabled: boolean): void;

	/** Read one feature flag. */
	getFeatureEnabled(id: ChartFeatureId | string): boolean;

	/** Snapshot of all runtime feature flags. */
	getFeatures(): FeatureFlags;

	/**
	 * Promise resolved when the top toolbar is ready for `createButton` (P3-4).
	 */
	headerReady(): Promise<void>;

	/**
	 * Create a custom header button (P3-4 / TV `createButton`).
	 * Returns `HTMLButtonElement` — set `textContent` / listen for `click`.
	 */
	createButton(options?: CreateButtonOptions): HTMLButtonElement;

	/**
	 * Create a custom header dropdown (P3-4 / TV `createDropdown`).
	 */
	createDropdown(options: CreateDropdownOptions): Promise<IDropdownApi>;

	/**
	 * Remove a button previously returned by `createButton` (P3-4).
	 */
	removeButton(button: HTMLElement | string): void;

	/**
	 * Register a keyboard shortcut (P3-5 / TV `onShortcut`).
	 * Returns an unsubscribe function. Ignored while focus is in an input.
	 */
	onShortcut(shortcut: ShortcutInput, callback: () => void): () => void;

	/**
	 * Inject items into the chart context menu (P3-5 / TV `onContextMenu`).
	 * Callback: `(unixtime, price) => ContextMenuItem[]`.
	 */
	onContextMenu(callback: ContextMenuCallback): void;

	/**
	 * Close open menus, portals, Redux popups, and host dialogs (P3-6).
	 */
	closePopupsAndDialogs(): void;

	/**
	 * Confirm dialog (P3-6 / TV `showConfirmDialog`).
	 * Resolves `true` on OK, `false` on Cancel / Escape.
	 */
	showConfirmDialog(
		titleOrParams: string | ConfirmDialogParams,
		content?: string | string[] | ((confirmed: boolean) => void),
		callbackOrOk?: ((confirmed: boolean) => void) | string,
		optionsOrCancel?: { okText?: string; cancelText?: string } | string,
	): Promise<boolean>;

	/**
	 * Notice dialog (P3-6 / TV `showNoticeDialog`). Resolves when dismissed.
	 */
	showNoticeDialog(
		titleOrParams: string | NoticeDialogParams,
		content?: string | string[],
		callback?: () => void,
	): Promise<void>;

	/** Select a drawing tool or cursor (P3-7 / TV `selectLineTool`). */
	selectLineTool(linetool: string): void;

	/** Currently selected line tool / cursor id (P3-7). */
	selectedLineTool(): string;

	/** Hide/show all drawings (P3-7) → `ISyncApi` over `hideAllDrawings`. */
	hideAllDrawingTools(): ISyncApi;

	/** Lock/unlock all drawings (P3-7) → `ISyncApi` over `lockAllDrawings`. */
	lockAllDrawingTools(): ISyncApi;

	/** Magnet on/off (P3-7) → `ISyncApi` over `magnetModeOnAllDrawings`. */
	magnetEnabled(): ISyncApi;

	/**
	 * Magnet strength stub (P3-7). GC has no weak/strong — `0` off, `1` on.
	 * Prefer `magnetEnabled()` for real control.
	 */
	magnetMode(): INumberSyncApi;

	/**
	 * Local chart screenshot (P3-8 / TV `takeClientScreenshot`).
	 * Returns a canvas — use `toDataURL()` / `toBlob()` as needed.
	 */
	takeClientScreenshot(
		options?: ClientSnapshotOptions,
	): Promise<HTMLCanvasElement>;

	/**
	 * Upload screenshot to `config.snapshot_url` (P3-8 / TV `takeScreenshot`).
	 * Resolves with the saved image URL; also emits `onScreenshotReady`.
	 */
	takeScreenshot(): Promise<string>;

	/** Clear undo / redo history (P3-9 / TV `clearUndoHistory`). */
	clearUndoHistory(): void;

	/** Snapshot of undo/redo enablement + labels (P3-9 / TV `undoRedoState`). */
	undoRedoState(): UndoRedoState;

	/**
	 * Invalidate cached bar data (P3-9 / TV `resetCache`).
	 * Clears sample lastBarsCache, calls `datafeed.resetCache` if present,
	 * and fires registered subscribe reset callbacks. Does not refetch alone.
	 */
	resetCache(): void;

	/**
	 * Catalog of available indicator type ids (P3-10 / TV `getStudiesList`).
	 * Returns GC `type` strings for `addIndicator({ type })` — not TV display names.
	 */
	getStudiesList(): string[];

	/**
	 * Input descriptors for a study (P3-10 / TV `getStudyInputs`).
	 * Accepts type, name, or displayName (case-insensitive).
	 */
	getStudyInputs(studyName: string): StudyInputInformation[];

	/**
	 * Style / plot metadata for a study (P3-10 / TV `getStudyStyles`).
	 * Plot keys match GC appearance field ids.
	 */
	getStudyStyles(studyName: string): StudyStyleInfo;

	/**
	 * SDK-visible chart type ids (P3-11 / TV `supportedChartTypes`).
	 * GC strings (e.g. `CANDLESTICK`), not TV numeric style enums.
	 */
	supportedChartTypes(): string[];

	/**
	 * Supported interval strings (P3-11 / TV `getIntervals`).
	 * GC suffixes (`1m`, `1D`, …); prefers active symbol `valid_intervals`,
	 * then datafeed `onReady` → `supported_resolutions`, then BASE_INTERVALS.
	 */
	getIntervals(): string[];

	/**
	 * Cached datafeed configuration from host `onReady` (P6-1).
	 * Returns `null` until the handshake completes (or immediately with defaults
	 * when the host omits `onReady`).
	 */
	getDatafeedConfiguration(): DatafeedConfiguration | null;

	/**
	 * Active chart symbol + interval (P3-11 / TV `symbolInterval`).
	 * Same shape as `activeChart().symbolInterval()`.
	 */
	symbolInterval(): SymbolIntervalResult | null;

	/**
	 * Active main-series price formatter (P3-12 / TV `mainSeriesPriceFormatter`).
	 * Same precision rules as `activeChart().priceFormatter()`.
	 */
	mainSeriesPriceFormatter(): PriceFormatter;

	/**
	 * Currency/unit label visibility (P3-12 / TV `currencyAndUnitVisibility`).
	 * v1: watched-value API; price-scale UI paint deferred.
	 */
	currencyAndUnitVisibility(): IVisibilityApi;

	/**
	 * Host-injectable custom symbol status (P3-12 / TV `customSymbolStatus`).
	 * Also covers TV `SeriesStatusViewSymbolTextSource` intent via host-driven
	 * chips beside symbol search (no separate series-status widget).
	 */
	customSymbolStatus(): ICustomSymbolStatusApi;

	/**
	 * Zoom / scroll navigation button visibility (P3-13 / TV `navigationButtonsVisibility`).
	 * Maps to `settings.navigationButton`.
	 */
	navigationButtonsVisibility(): IVisibilityWatchedValue;

	/**
	 * Multi-pane chrome button visibility (P3-13 / TV `paneButtonsVisibility`).
	 * Maps to `settings.paneButton`.
	 */
	paneButtonsVisibility(): IVisibilityWatchedValue;

	/**
	 * X-axis date format (P3-13 / TV `dateFormat`).
	 * GC ids (e.g. `d_mmm_yy`); also accepts common TV display strings.
	 */
	dateFormat(): IStringWatchedValue;

	/**
	 * X-axis hours format (P3-13 / TV `timeHoursFormat`).
	 * Stores `"12"` / `"24"`; accepts `"12-hours"` / `"24-hours"`.
	 */
	timeHoursFormat(): IStringWatchedValue;

	/**
	 * Cross-chart symbol sync (`layoutStore.syncSymbols`).
	 * `setValue(true)` fans out the active chart symbol.
	 */
	symbolSync(): ISyncApi;

	/**
	 * Cross-chart interval sync (`layoutStore.syncIntervals`).
	 * `setValue(true)` fans out the active chart interval.
	 */
	intervalSync(): ISyncApi;

	/**
	 * Draw on all charts (`layoutStore.syncDrawings`) — P2-5 / TV `drawOnAllChartsEnabled`.
	 */
	drawOnAllChartsEnabled(): ISyncApi;

	/**
	 * Crosshair sync (`layoutStore.syncCursors`) — P2-4.
	 */
	crosshairSync(): ISyncApi;

	/**
	 * Visible date-range sync (`layoutStore.syncDateRange`) — P2-4.
	 */
	dateRangeSync(): ISyncApi;

	/**
	 * Time / scroll sync (`layoutStore.syncTime`) — P2-4.
	 */
	timeSync(): ISyncApi;

	/**
	 * Subscribe to widget events.
	 * Mapped: `activeChartChanged` ← CHART_SELECTED, `layout` ← CHART_MODE_CHANGED.
	 * Raw `appCallback` eventType strings are also emitted.
	 */
	subscribe(event: WidgetSubscribeEvent, callback: WidgetSubscribeCallback): void;

	/**
	 * Unsubscribe a previously registered handler.
	 */
	unsubscribe(event: WidgetSubscribeEvent, callback: WidgetSubscribeCallback): void;

	/**
	 * Get all charts and multicharting status.
	 */
	getAllCharts(): MultiChartInfo;

	/**
	 * Set broker account data for trading features
	 * @param data - Broker account data including accounts, orders, trades, and positions
	 */
	setBrokerAccounts(data: BrokerAccountData): void;

	/**
	 * Update existing positions without a full setBrokerAccounts rebuild.
	 * Merges partial updates into positions matched by `key`.
	 * Useful for updating dynamic fields like pnlMultiplier, bid, ask, ltp
	 * that change frequently (e.g. cross-currency conversion rates).
	 * @param positions - Array of partial position updates (must include `key`)
	 */
	updatePositions(positions: Array<Partial<Position> & Pick<Position, 'key'>>): void;

	/**
	 * Change the symbol
	 * @param newSymbol - New symbol to display
	 */
	setSymbol(newSymbol: string): void;

	/**
	 * Change the interval
	 * @param newInterval - New time interval
	 */
	setInterval(newInterval: string): void;

	/**
	 * Change the theme
	 * @param newTheme - The theme to apply ('light' or 'dark')
	 */
	setTheme(newTheme: "light" | "dark"): void;

	/**
	 * Resize the chart
	 * @param width - New width
	 * @param height - New height
	 */
	resize(width: number | string, height: number | string): void;

	/**
	 * Change symbol of a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param newSymbol - New symbol to display
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to change (0-based)
	 */
	setChartSymbolAtIndex(newSymbol: string, chartIdx: number): void;

	/**
	 * Change interval of a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param newInterval - New interval to display
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to change (0-based)
	 */
	setIntervalAtIndex(newInterval: string, chartIdx: number): void;

	/**
	 * Add an indicator to the currently selected chart
	 * @param indicator - Indicator object with type and id properties
	 */
	addIndicator(indicator: { type?: string; id?: string }): void;

	/**
	 * Add an indicator to a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param indicator - Indicator object with type and id properties
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to add indicator to (0-based)
	 */
	addIndicatorAtIndex(
		indicator: { type?: string; id?: string },
		chartIdx: number,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Add a drawing to the currently selected chart
	 * @param drawing - Drawing object with type/name, options, and appearance properties
	 * @param chartId - Chart ID to add the drawing to (default: "MAIN_CHART")
	 */
	addDrawing(
		drawing: {
			type?: string;
			name?: string;
			options?: DrawingOptions;
			appearance?: DrawingAppearance;
		},
		chartId?: string,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Add a drawing to a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param drawing - Drawing object with type/name, options, and appearance properties
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to add drawing to (0-based)
	 * @param chartId - Chart ID to add the drawing to (default: "MAIN_CHART")
	 */
	addDrawingAtIndex(
		drawing: {
			type?: string;
			name?: string;
			options?: DrawingOptions;
			appearance?: DrawingAppearance;
		},
		chartIdx: number,
		chartId?: string,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Delete an object (drawing or indicator) from the currently selected chart
	 * @param objectId - ID of the object to delete
	 * @param chartId - Chart ID to delete the object from (default: "MAIN_CHART")
	 */
	deleteObject(objectId: string, chartId?: string): void;

	/**
	 * Delete an object (drawing or indicator) from a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param objectId - ID of the object to delete
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to delete object from (0-based)
	 * @param chartId - Chart ID to delete the object from (default: "MAIN_CHART")
	 */
	deleteObjectAtIndex(
		objectId: string,
		chartIdx: number,
		chartId?: string,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Update chart settings for the currently selected chart
	 * @param settings - Settings object to update
	 */
	updateSettings(settings: Partial<ChartSettings>): void;

	/**
	 * Update chart settings for a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param settings - Settings object to update
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to update settings for (0-based)
	 */
	updateSettingsAtIndex(
		settings: Partial<ChartSettings>,
		chartIdx: number,
	): void;

	/**
	 * Get the complete chart state for the currently selected chart
	 * @returns The complete chart state object, or null if chart is not available
	 */
	getChartState(): ChartState | null;

	/**
	 * Get the complete chart state for a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to get state from (0-based)
	 * @returns The complete chart state object, or null if chart is not available
	 */
	getChartStateAtIndex(chartIdx: number): ChartState | null;

	/**
	 * Set the complete chart state for the currently selected chart
	 * @param newState - The new chart state object to set
	 */
	setChartState(newState: ChartState): void;

	/**
	 * Set the complete chart state for a specific chart by index in multichart mode
	 * @param newState - The new chart state object to set
	 * @param chartIdx - Index of the chart to set state for (0-based)
	 */
	setChartStateAtIndex(newState: ChartState, chartIdx: number): void;

	/**
	 * Resubscribe to all active subscriptions after reconnection
	 * @param idToken - Optional authentication token for resubscription
	 */
	resubscribeAll(idToken?: string): void;
};

	enabled?: boolean;

	/** Grid color */
	color?: string;

	/** Grid line style */
	style?: "solid" | "dashed" | "dotted";
};

/**
 * Chart appearance configuration for defaultInitialChartConfig
 */
export type ChartAppearanceConfig = {
	/** Background color */
	backgroundColor?: string;

	/** Grid appearance settings */
	grid?: GridAppearance;
};

 * Chart settings configuration for defaultInitialChartConfig
 */
export type ChartSettingsConfig = {
	/** Show or hide crosshair plus icon (default: true) */
	showCrosshairPlusIcon?: boolean;

	/** Timezone for chart display (e.g., "America/New_York", "Asia/Kolkata") */

	/** Show grid lines */
	showGrid?: boolean;

	/** Show volume bars */

 *     zone: "America/New_York",

	/** Chart settings overrides */

	/** Chart appearance overrides */

/**
 * Trading configuration options
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * trading: {
 *   enableTrading: true,
 *   showReverseButton: true,
 *   showOpenOrders: true,
 *   showPositions: true,
 *   showExecutions: true,
 *   beep: true,
 *   quickTradeMode: false,
 *   enableTakeProfitDefaults: true,
 *   defaultTakeProfitSpread: 10,
 *   defaultTakeProfitSpreadType: "tick",
 *   enableStopLossDefaults: true,
 *   defaultStopLossSpread: 5,
 *   defaultStopLossSpreadType: "tick",
 *   boxAlignment: "right",
 *   lineCategory: "extended"
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type TradingConfig = {
	// ========================================================================
	// Core Trading Settings
	// ========================================================================

	/** Enable trading features (default: false) */
	enableTrading?: boolean;

	// ========================================================================
	// UI Display Options
	// ========================================================================

	/** Show reverse button in trading panel (default: true) */
	showReverseButton?: boolean;

	/** Show open orders panel (default: true) */
	showOpenOrders?: boolean;

	/** Show positions panel (default: true) */
	showPositions?: boolean;

	/** Show executions/trades panel (default: true) */
	showExecutions?: boolean;

	/** Show notifications panel (default: true) */
	showNotifications?: boolean;

	// ========================================================================
	// Trading Behavior
	// ========================================================================

	/** Enable beep sound on order execution (default: true) */
	beep?: boolean;

	/** Enable quick trade mode (default: false) */
	quickTradeMode?: boolean;

	/** Enable Stop order options in context menus (default: false) */
	supportStopOrders?: boolean;

	/** Enable Stop-Limit order options in context menus (default: false) */
	supportStopLimitOrders?: boolean;

	// ========================================================================
	// Take Profit Settings
	// ========================================================================

	/** Enable take profit defaults (default: false) */
	enableTakeProfitDefaults?: boolean;

	/** Default take profit spread (default: 1) */
	defaultTakeProfitSpread?: number;

	/** Default take profit spread type: "tick" | "price" | "percent" (default: "tick") */
	defaultTakeProfitSpreadType?: "tick" | "price" | "percent";

	// ========================================================================
	// Stop Loss Settings
	// ========================================================================

	/** Enable stop loss defaults (default: false) */
	enableStopLossDefaults?: boolean;

	/** Default stop loss spread (default: 1) */
	defaultStopLossSpread?: number;

	/** Default stop loss spread type: "tick" | "price" | "percent" (default: "tick") */
	defaultStopLossSpreadType?: "tick" | "price" | "percent";

	// ========================================================================
	// Position Display Settings
	// ========================================================================

	/** Trading box alignment: "left" | "right" (default: "right") */
	boxAlignment?: "left" | "right";

	/** Order/position line category: "extended" | "compact" (default: "extended") */
	lineCategory?: "extended" | "compact";
};

/**
 * Context menu configuration options
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * contextMenu: {
 *   showTradingOptions: true
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type ContextMenuOptions = {
	/** Show trading options in context menu */
	showTradingOptions?: boolean;
	/**
	 * TV `context_menu.items_processor` — post-process items returned from
	 * `onContextMenu` before they merge with built-ins. May return a new array
	 * or mutate via `-Label` remove entries.
	 */
	items_processor?: (
		items: ContextMenuItem[],
		unixtime: number,
		price: number,
	) => ContextMenuItem[] | void;
	/** CamelCase alias of items_processor */
	itemsProcessor?: ContextMenuOptions["items_processor"];
	/**
	 * TV ContextMenuRendererFactory — pragmatic v1: return ContextMenuItem[]
	 * overrides (same pipeline as items_processor). Full custom React trees
	 * are not supported.
	 */
	renderer_factory?: (args: {
		items: ContextMenuItem[];
		unixtime: number;
		price: number;
	}) => ContextMenuItem[] | void;
	rendererFactory?: ContextMenuOptions["renderer_factory"];
};

/**
 * Discriminated union type for app callback events
 * Enables switch case type narrowing on eventType
 *
 * Each variant has `eventType` as the discriminant and `message` typed accordingly.
 * Use this with `AppCallbackEventHandler` for switch case type narrowing.
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // TypeScript will narrow `event.message` based on `event.eventType` in switch cases
 * switch (event.eventType) {
 *   case "PLACE_ORDER":
 *     console.log(event.message.order); // message is PlaceOrderMessage
 *     break;
 *   case "CREATE_ORDER":
 *     console.log(event.message.side); // message is CreateOrderMessage
 *     break;
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type AppCallbackEvent = {
	[K in AppCallbackEventType]: {
		eventType: K;
		message: AppCallbackEventMap[K];
		onClose?: () => void;
	};
}[AppCallbackEventType];

/**
 * App callback handler with discriminated union for switch case type narrowing
 *
 * Use this type when you need to handle events in a switch statement.
 * The message type is automatically narrowed based on eventType in switch cases.
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * const handler: AppCallbackEventHandler = (event) => {
 *   switch (event.eventType) {
 *     case "PLACE_ORDER":
 *       // event.message is automatically typed as PlaceOrderMessage
 *       console.log("Order:", event.message.order);
 *       break;
 *     case "CREATE_ORDER":
 *       // event.message is automatically typed as CreateOrderMessage
 *       console.log("Side:", event.message.side, "Price:", event.message.price);
 *       break;
 *     case "MODIFY_ORDER":
 *       // event.message is automatically typed as ModifyOrderMessage
 *       console.log("Modifying order:", event.message.orderId);
 *       break;
 *     case "CANCEL_ORDER":
 *       // event.message is automatically typed as Order
 *       console.log("Cancelling order:", event.message.orderId);
 *       break;
 *   }
 * };
 * ```
 */
export type AppCallbackEventHandler = (event: AppCallbackEvent) => void;

export type OnReadyEventHandler = (chartInstance: ChartInstance) => void;

/** Fired after successful `saveChartToServer` (TV SaveChartToServerCallback). */
export type SaveChartToServerCallback = (
	id: string,
	meta?: { name?: string; id?: string },
) => void;

/** TV SuggestedChartChangeAdapter — gate/notify symbol & interval changes. */
export type SuggestedChartChange = {
	kind: "symbol" | "interval" | "symbolInterval";
	symbol?: string;
	interval?: string;
	fromSymbol?: string | null;
	fromInterval?: string | null;
};

export type SuggestedChartChangeAdapter = {
	canAcceptSuggestedChange?: (
		change: SuggestedChartChange,
	) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
	onSuggestedChange?: (change: SuggestedChartChange) => void;
};

export type OnErrorEventHandler = (error: Error | ChartError | string) => void;

export type OnSymbolChangeEventHandler = (symbolInfo: SymbolInfo) => void;

export type OnIntervalChangeEventHandler = (interval: string) => void;

/**
 * Chart configuration object for createChart function
 */
export type ChartConfig = {
	// ========================================================================
	// Required Properties
	// ========================================================================

	/** Datafeed object with required methods for fetching chart data */
	datafeed: Datafeed;

	/** Initial symbol to display (e.g., "AAPL", "BYBIT:FUTURE:BTCUSDT") */
	symbol: string;

	/** Initial time interval (e.g., "1m", "5m", "1D") */
	interval: string;

	/** Your SDK license key */
	licenseKey: string;

	// ========================================================================
	// Display Options
	// ========================================================================

	/** Chart theme - 'light' or 'dark' (default: "light") */
	theme?: ChartTheme;

	/**
	 * Theme background color as a hex string (e.g. `"#22292f"`, `"#ffffff"`).
	 * Prefer `theme: "light" | "dark"` when you only need the named mode —
	 * that maps to `#ffffff` / `#22292f` when `themeColor` is omitted.
	 */
	themeColor?: string;

	/** Enable automatic resizing (default: true) */
	autosize?: boolean;

	/** Chart width - number in pixels or string with units (default: "100%") */
	width?: number | string;

	/** Chart height - number in pixels or string with units (default: "100%") */
	height?: number | string;

	/** Locale for internationalization (e.g., "en-US", "en") (default: "en-US") */
	locale?: string;

	// ========================================================================
	// Feature Flags
	// ========================================================================

	/** Enable debug logging to console (default: false) */
	debugLog?: boolean;

	/** Hide search bar in top bar (default: false) */
	disableSearch?: boolean;

	/** Hide compare button in top bar (default: false) */
	disableCompare?: boolean;

	/** Hide drawing toolbar in top bar (default: false) */
	hideDrawingToolBar?: boolean;

	/**
	 * Construct-time featureset: feature strings to disable at construct time (P4-1).
	 * Known ids/aliases map onto `exclude` / `disableSearch` / `disableCompare` / `hideDrawingToolBar`.
	 * Unknown strings are kept on config and warned once in the console.
	 *
	 * @example
	 * ```typescript
	 * disabled_features: ["header_widget", "left_toolbar", "header_symbol_search"]
	 * ```
	 */
	disabled_features?: string[];

	/**
	 * Construct-time featureset: feature strings to enable at construct time (P4-1).
	 * Applied after `disabled_features` (can re-enable a disabled feature).
	 */
	enabled_features?: string[];

	/**
	 * Construct-time appearance overrides (P4-2). Merged into
	 * `defaultInitialChartConfig.appearance` and re-applied after charts exist.
	 * Same GC nested shape as runtime `applyOverrides` (not full TV dotted paths).
	 */
	overrides?: Record<string, any>;

	/**
	 * Construct-time study style/option overrides keyed by indicator type (P4-2).
	 * Re-applied after charts exist via `applyStudiesOverrides`.
	 */
	studies_overrides?: Record<string, any>;

	/**
	 * Construct-time chart `settings` merge (P4-2) into
	 * `defaultInitialChartConfig.settings`.
	 */
	settings_overrides?: Record<string, any>;

	/** P4-3: inject stylesheet once (`addCustomCSSFile`). */
	custom_css_url?: string;
	/** P4-3: CSS theme tokens via `customThemes()`. */
	custom_themes?: Record<string, any>;
	/** P4-3 / P4-5: IANA timezone → `settings.zone`. */
	timezone?: string;
	/** P4-3 store-only (accepted, not applied to chrome). */
	custom_font_family?: string;
	custom_formatters?: Record<string, any>;
	custom_timezones?: any[];
	custom_translate_function?: (...args: any[]) => any;

	/** Host gate for symbol/interval changes (TV SuggestedChartChangeAdapter). */
	suggested_chart_change_adapter?: SuggestedChartChangeAdapter;
	suggestedChartChangeAdapter?: SuggestedChartChangeAdapter;

	/** P4-4 soft: studies blacklist → `exclude.indicators`. */
	studies_access?: any;
	/** P4-4 soft: drawings access — stored; hard UI deferred. */
	drawings_access?: any;
	/** P4-4 soft: warn when study count exceeds (no hard block). */
	study_count_limit?: number;

	/** P4-5: TV favorites → GC `favourite` keys. */
	favorites?: Record<string, any>;
	/** P4-5: constrain interval picker / `getIntervals`. */
	time_frames?: Array<string | Record<string, any>>;
	/** P4-5: after init `activeChart().setTimeFrame(...)`. */
	timeframe?: string | Record<string, any>;

	/** P4-6: toolbar background CSS var. */
	toolbar_bg?: string;
	/** P4-6: alias of `contextMenu`. */
	context_menu?: ContextMenuOptions;
	/** P4-6 stubs — accepted, not yet applied. */
	loading_screen?: any;
	numeric_formatting?: any;
	compare_symbols?: any;
	/** Live — debounce (ms) for the symbol search box before `datafeed.searchSymbols` fires. Default 100. */
	symbol_search_request_delay?: number;
	symbol_search_complete?: any;
	symbol_search_symbols_types?: any;
	header_widget_buttons_mode?: string;
	additional_symbol_info_fields?: any;

	/**
	 * P4-7 / P5: save/load adapter shape (behavior wired in Phase 5).
	 * `takeScreenshot` prefers `image_storage_adapter` over `snapshot_url`.
	 * Study-template methods (`getAllStudyTemplates`, `saveStudyTemplate`, …)
	 * are used by `createStudyTemplate` / localStorage default adapter.
	 */
	save_load_adapter?: Record<string, any>;
	settings_adapter?: Record<string, any>;
	image_storage_adapter?: Record<string, any>;
	charts_storage_url?: string;
	charts_storage_api_version?: string;
	client_id?: string;
	user_id?: string;

	/**
	 * Debounce (seconds) before `onAutoSaveNeeded` after chart dirty
	 * (TV `auto_save_delay`). Default 5. Host should call `saveChartToServer`.
	 */
	auto_save_delay?: number;
	/**
	 * Fired after a successful `saveChartToServer` (TV SaveChartToServerCallback).
	 */
	save_chart_to_server_callback?: SaveChartToServerCallback;
	/** CamelCase alias of save_chart_to_server_callback */
	saveChartToServerCallback?: SaveChartToServerCallback;
	/**
	 * After init, load the newest named chart from `save_load_adapter`
	 * (TV `load_last_chart`). Ignored when `saved_data` is set.
	 */
	load_last_chart?: boolean;
	/**
	 * Layout blob applied after hydrate (TV `saved_data`).
	 * Takes precedence over `load_last_chart`.
	 */
	saved_data?: Record<string, any> | string;

	/**
	 * TV `snapshot_url` — POST endpoint for `takeScreenshot()` when no image_storage_adapter.
	 * Expects multipart field `preparedImage` (PNG); response body is the image URL.
	 */
	snapshot_url?: string;

	/** Enable always draw mode (default: false) */
	alwaysDrawMode?: boolean;

	/** Auto-save chart state to sessionStorage for restoration on page reload (default: true) */
	autoSave?: boolean;

	/**
	 * Force the mobile chart shell (`TerminalMobileChart`) regardless of user agent.
	 * Full JS Chart-tab UX: mobile top/bottom bars, JS ContextMenu, Layers sheets.
	 * Sets `window.__GOCHARTING_TOUCH_MODE__` for the chart lifetime. Default: `false`.
	 */
	touchMode?: boolean;

	/**
	 * Native / Flutter / iOS / Android / RN WebView mode.
	 * Uses the mobile chart canvas (same shell entry as `touchMode`) but:
	 * - hides JS TopBar and BottomBar (host owns chrome)
	 * - suppresses JS ContextMenu and emits `OPEN_CONTEXT_MENU` via `appCallback`
	 * - Layers sheets stay in JS for now
	 * - every TerminalMobile `appCallback` is also posted via `sendToNative`
	 * Prefer combining with `touchMode: true` only when you also want JS bars.
	 * Default: `false`.
	 */
	isNativeApp?: boolean;

	/**
	 * Which chrome the SDK draws in native host mode (`isNativeApp: true`).
	 *
	 * - `"none"` (default) — canvas only. The host owns every menu. Use this
	 *   when you build native toolbars and drive the chart through `window.chart`.
	 * - `"toolbar"` — keep the JS mobile **bottom** toolbar (interval, drawing
	 *   tools, indicators, layers). A quick way to ship a working mobile chart
	 *   before you have native menus. The top bar (symbol search / compare)
	 *   stays hidden either way — that is always the host's job.
	 *
	 * Ignored unless `isNativeApp` is true.
	 */
	nativeChrome?: "none" | "toolbar";

	// ========================================================================
	// Configuration Overrides (Root State Overrides)
	// ========================================================================

	/**
	 * Override default initial chart configuration
	 * Applied after localStorage hydration to override chart settings
	 *
	 * @example
	 * ```typescript
	 * defaultInitialChartConfig: {
	 *   settings: {
	 *     showCrosshairPlusIcon: false,
	 *     zone: "America/New_York",
	 *   },
	 *   appearance: {
	 *     backgroundColor: "#1a1a1a",
	 *     grid: { enabled: true, color: "#2a2a2a" }
	 *   }
	 * }
	 * ```
	 */
	defaultInitialChartConfig?: DefaultInitialChartConfig;

	/**
	 * Trading configuration overrides
	 *
	 * @example
	 * ```typescript
	 * trading: {
	 *   enableTrading: true,
	 *   showOpenOrders: true,
	 *   showPositions: true,
	 *   beep: true,
	 *   enableTakeProfitDefaults: true,
	 *   defaultTakeProfitSpread: 10,
	 *   defaultTakeProfitSpreadType: "tick"
	 * }
	 * ```
	 */
	trading?: TradingConfig;

	/**
	 * Optional deep-merge into root `popups` panel state (panel ids such as
	 * `Settings`, `TradingPanel`, `Layers`). Not for enabling welcome/tutorial dialogs.
	 *
	 * @example
	 * ```typescript
	 * popups: {
	 *   TradingPanel: { title: "Order Ticket" },
	 *   Settings: { defaultTab: "Chart" },
	 * }
	 * ```
	 */
	popups?: PopupsConfig;

	/**
	 * Favorite intervals, drawings, indicators, chart types, and templates.
	 * Keys are `INTERVALS`, `DRAWINGS`, `INDICATOR`, `CHARTTYPES`, `TEMPLATES`, etc.
	 *
	 * @example
	 * ```typescript
	 * favourite: {
	 *   INTERVALS: ["1m", "5m", "1D"],
	 *   INDICATOR: ["RSI", "MACD"],
	 * }
	 * ```
	 */
	favourite?: FavouriteConfig;

	/**
	 * Context menu configuration
	 *
	 * @example
	 * ```typescript
	 * contextMenu: {
	 *   showTradingOptions: true
	 * }
	 * ```
	 */
	contextMenu?: ContextMenuOptions;

	// ========================================================================
	// UI Customization
	// ========================================================================

	/**
	 * Object to exclude specific UI elements or features
	 * @example { leftPanel: true, rightPanel: true, topBar: true }
	 */
	exclude?: ExcludeOptions;

	// ========================================================================
	// Event Callbacks
	// ========================================================================

	/**
	 * Callback for trading events and application-level events
	 * Handles all chart events including trading, alerts, data downloads, and UI interactions
	 *
	 * Receives a single event object with `eventType`, `message`, and optional `onClose`.
	 * The `message` type is automatically narrowed based on `eventType` in switch/case statements.
	 *
	 * @example
	 * ```typescript
	 * appCallback: (event) => {
	 *   switch (event.eventType) {
	 *     case "PLACE_ORDER":
	 *       // event.message is PlaceOrderMessage
	 *       console.log("Order:", event.message.order);
	 *       break;
	 *     case "CREATE_ORDER":
	 *       // event.message is CreateOrderMessage
	 *       console.log("Side:", event.message.side);
	 *       break;
	 *     case "MODIFY_ORDER":
	 *       // event.message is ModifyOrderMessage
	 *       console.log("Modifying:", event.message.orderId);
	 *       break;
	 *     case "CANCEL_ORDER":
	 *       // event.message is Order
	 *       console.log("Cancelling:", event.message.orderId);
	 *       break;
	 * }
	 * ```
	 */
	appCallback?: AppCallbackEventHandler;

	/**
	 * Callback when chart is ready and initialized
	 * @param chartInstance - The ProfessionalChart React component instance
	 *
	 * **Note:** This receives the raw React component instance, NOT the wrapper returned by createChart().
	 * The wrapper (ChartWrapper) has additional methods like isDestroyed().
	 *
	 * @example
	 * ```typescript
	 * const chart = createChart('#container', {
	 *   onReady: (chartInstance) => {
	 *     // chartInstance is ChartInstance (React component)
	 *     chartInstance.setBrokerAccounts(data); // ✅ Available
	 *     chartInstance.setSymbol('AAPL');       // ✅ Available
	 *     // chartInstance.isDestroyed();        // ❌ NOT available (only on wrapper)
	 *   }
	 * });
	 *
	 * // chart is ChartWrapper (has isDestroyed, destroy, etc.)
	 * chart.isDestroyed(); // ✅ Available on wrapper
	 * ```
	 */
	onReady?: OnReadyEventHandler;

	/**
	 * Callback for errors during chart initialization or operation
	 * @param error - Error object or message
	 */
	onError?: OnErrorEventHandler;

	// ========================================================================
	// Additional Properties (for extensibility)
	// ========================================================================
};

// ============================================================================
// Event Types
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Chart click event
 */
export type ChartClickEvent = {
	/** X coordinate */
	x: number;

	/** Y coordinate */
	y: number;

	/** Price at click location */
	price: number;

	/** Time at click location */
	time: number;

	/** Ctrl key pressed */
	ctrlKey?: boolean;

	/** Shift key pressed */
	shiftKey?: boolean;

	/** Alt key pressed */
	altKey?: boolean;
};

/**
 * Crosshair move event
 */
export type CrosshairMoveEvent = {
	/** Price at crosshair */
	price: number;

	/** Time at crosshair */
	time: number;

	/** X coordinate */
	x: number;

	/** Y coordinate */
	y: number;
};

/**
 * Drawing point
 */
export type DrawingPoint = {
	/** Time coordinate */
	time: number;

	/** Price coordinate */
	price: number;
};

/**
 * Drawing style
 */
export type DrawingStyle = {
	/** Line color */
	color?: string;

	/** Line width */
	width?: number;

	/** Line style */
	style?: "solid" | "dashed" | "dotted";
};

/**
 * Drawing object
 */
export type DrawingObject = {
	/** Unique drawing ID */
	id: string;

	/** Drawing type */
	type: string;

	/** Drawing points */
	points: DrawingPoint[];

	/** Drawing style */
	style: DrawingStyle;
};

/**
 * Timescale mark for marking important events on the chart
 */
export type TimescaleMark = {
	/** Unique mark ID */
	id: string | number;

	/** Time coordinate (Unix timestamp) */
	time: number;

	/** Mark color */
	color: string;

	/** Mark label text (may be empty when imageUrl is set) */
	label: string;

	/** Tooltip text */
	tooltip?: string | string[];

	/** Optional image shown inside the mark (TV parity) */
	imageUrl?: string;

	/** Keep letter label visible after imageUrl loads (default false) */
	showLabelWhenImageLoaded?: boolean;

	/** Label font color */
	labelFontColor?: string;

	/** Mark shape (TV timescale: circle / square / earningUp / earningDown) */
	shape?:
		| "circle"
		| "square"
		| "arrowUp"
		| "arrowDown"
		| "earningUp"
		| "earningDown";
};

/**
 * Mark for displaying events/annotations on the chart (used by getMarks)
 */
export type Mark = {
	/** Unique mark ID */
	id: number | string;

	/** Time coordinate (Unix timestamp in seconds) */
	time: number;

	/** Mark color */
	color: string;

	/** Text to display in mark popup (can be string or array of strings for multiple lines) */
	text: string | string[];

	/** Short label text displayed on the mark (may be empty when imageUrl is set) */
	label: string;

	/** Label font color */
	labelFontColor?: string;

	/** Minimum size of the mark in pixels */
	minSize?: number;

	/** Optional image shown inside the mark (TV parity) */
	imageUrl?: string;

	/** Keep letter label visible after imageUrl loads (default false) */
	showLabelWhenImageLoaded?: boolean;
};

/**
 * Order placement message
 * Received when user places an order from the chart
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // PLACE_ORDER event message
 * {
 *   order: {
 *     side: "buy",
 *     orderType: "limit",
 *     price: 50000,
 *     size: 0.1,
 *     stopLoss: 49000,
 *     takeProfit: 52000,
 *     task: "placement"
 *   },
 *   security: {
 *     symbol: "BTCUSDT",
 *     exchange: "BYBIT",
 *     segment: "FUTURE"
 *   },
 *   ltp: 50100
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type PlaceOrderMessage = {
	/** Order details */
	order: Partial<Order>;
	/** Security information */
	security?: SymbolInfo | SecurityInfo;
	/** Last traded price */
	ltp?: number;
	/** Additional state parameters */
	stateParams?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

/**
 * Order modification message
 * Received when user modifies an existing order (drag TP/SL, change price, etc.)
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // MODIFY_ORDER event message
 * {
 *   orderId: "ORDER_001",
 *   order: {
 *     orderId: "ORDER_001",
 *     price: 51000,
 *     stopLoss: 49500,
 *     takeProfit: 53000,
 *     task: "modify",
 *     update: "SHAPE_MODIFY",
 *     updateType: "STOP_LOSS"
 *   },
 *   security: {
 *     symbol: "BTCUSDT",
 *     exchange: "BYBIT",
 *     segment: "FUTURE"
 *   }
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type ModifyOrderMessage = {
	/** Order ID to modify */
	orderId: string;
	/** Updated order details */
	order: Partial<Order>;
	/** Security information */
	security?: SymbolInfo | SecurityInfo;
};

export type CancelOrderMessage = {
	order: Partial<Order>;
};

/**
 * Position modification message
 * Received when user modifies a position (drag TP/SL, etc.)
 * The position object contains both the position data and the modification details
 * including the update/updateType fields indicating what was changed.
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // MODIFY_POSITION event message
 * {
 *   position: {
 *     id: "POS_001",
 *     symbol: "BTCUSDT",
 *     size: 0.5,
 *     price: 48000,
 *     stopLoss: 47000,
 *     takeProfit: 55000,
 *     update: "SHAPE_MODIFY",
 *     updateType: "NEW_STOP_LOSS"
 *   }
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type ModifyPositionMessage = {
	/** Position with modification details (includes update/updateType fields) */
	position: Position;
	/** Position ID (alternative to position.id) */
	id?: string;
};

/**
 * Alert creation/modification message
 * Received when user creates or modifies an alert
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // CREATE_ALERT event message
 * {
 *   alert: {
 *     symbol: "BTCUSDT",
 *     price: 55000,
 *     condition: "above",
 *     message: "BTC above 55k!"
 *   }
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type AlertMessage = {
	/** Alert details */
	alert: {
		symbol: string;
		price: number;
		condition: "above" | "below" | "cross";
		message?: string;
	};
};

/**
 * Data download message
 * Received when chart needs more historical data (pan left, go to date)
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // DOWNLOAD_MORE_DATA event message
 * {
 *   params: [1704067200, 1704153600],  // [start_timestamp, end_timestamp]
 *   store: {
 *     getState: () => ({
 *       security: { symbol: "BTCUSDT", exchange: "BYBIT" },
 *       interval: "1D"
 *     })
 *   }
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type DownloadDataMessage = {
	/** Parameters for data download */
	params: [number, number] | [number, number, unknown];
	/** Store reference */
	store?: {
		getState: () => Record<string, unknown>;
	};
};

/**
 * UI event message
 * Received when user opens settings, layers, or other UI panels
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // OPEN_OBJECT_PROPERTIES event message
 * {
 *   chartId: "MAIN_CHART",
 *   objectId: "drawing_123",
 *   defaultTab: "style"
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type UIEventMessage = {
	/** Chart ID */
	chartId?: string;
	/** Object ID */
	objectId?: string;
	/** Default tab */
	defaultTab?: string;

	chartId: string;
	symbol: string;
	interval: string;
	idx: number;
	id: string;
};

/**
 * Chart selected message
 * Received when user selects a chart
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // CHART_SELECTED event message
 * {
 *   chartId: "MAIN_CHART",
 *   symbol: "BTCUSDT",
 *   interval: "1D",
 *   idx: 0,
 *   id: "MAIN_CHART"
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type ChartSelectedMessage = {
	/** Chart ID */
	id: string;

	/** Chart ID */
	chartId: string;

	/** Chart index */
	idx: number;

	/** Symbol */
	symbol: string;

	/** Interval */
	interval: string;
};

/**
 * Open context menu message (isNativeApp hosts)
 * Emitted on long-press / right-click when JS ContextMenu is suppressed.
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // OPEN_CONTEXT_MENU event message
 * {
 *   chartId: "MAIN_CHART",
 *   type: "chart",
 *   x: 120,
 *   y: 340,
 *   details: { type: "chart" },
 *   security: { symbol: "BTCUSDT", ... },
 *   interval: "1m"
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type OpenContextMenuMessage = {
	/** Chart ID */
	chartId: string;
	/** Hit-test details from the chart widget */
	details?: any;
	/** Shortcut for details.type (chart | series | object | axis | ...) */
	type?: string;
	/** Drawing / series object id when applicable */
	objectId?: string;
	/** Client X of the gesture */
	x?: number;
	/** Client Y of the gesture */
	y?: number;
	/** Current chart security */
	security?: any;
	/** Current interval */
	interval?: string;
};

/**
 * Create order message
 * Received when user initiates order creation from chart UI (e.g., order form opened)
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // CREATE_ORDER event message
 * {
 *   side: "buy",
 *   quantity: 1,
 *   price: 50000,
 *   symbol: "BTCUSDT"
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type CreateOrderMessage = {
	/** Order side */
	side?: OrderSide;
	/** Order quantity */
	quantity?: number;
	/** Order price (0 or undefined for market orders) */
	price?: number;
	/** Symbol */
	symbol?: string;
	/** Security information */
	security?: SymbolInfo | SecurityInfo;
	/** Last traded price */
	ltp?: number;
};

/**
 * Close position message
 * Received when user requests to close a position
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // CLOSE_POSITION event message
 * {
 *   position: {
 *     id: "POS_123",
 *     symbol: "BTCUSDT",
 *     size: 0.5
 *   }
 * }
 * ```
 */
export type ClosePositionMessage = {
	/** Position to close */
	position?: Position;
	/** Position ID (alternative to position object) */
	id?: string;
	/** Position ID (alias) */
	positionId?: string;
};

/** Payload for `REVERSE_POSITION` (position line ↻ button). */
export type ReversePositionMessage = {
	/** Position to reverse */
	position?: Position;
	/** Position ID (alternative to position object) */
	id?: string;
	/** Position ID (alias) */
	positionId?: string;
};

/**
 * Chart widget instance (internal React component)
 * Access via chart.getChartInstance()
 *
 * @deprecated Use ChartInstance instead. This type is kept for backward compatibility.
 */
export type ChartWidgetInstance = ChartInstance;

// ============================================================================
// Duration Types
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Duration string for chart data range
 * Used with getDateRangeForDuration() to calculate start/end dates
 */
export type DurationString =
	| "1D"
	| "5D"
	| "15D"
	| "1M"
	| "3M"
	| "6M"
	| "1Y"
	| "5Y"
	| "All";

/**
 * Result from getDateRangeForDuration()
 * Contains calculated start/end timestamps and recommended interval
 */
export type DateRangeResult = {
	/** Start timestamp in milliseconds */
	start_date: number;

	/** End timestamp in milliseconds (current time) */
	end_date: number;

	/** Recommended interval for this duration (e.g., "1m", "15m", "1h", "1D") */
	interval: string;
};

/**
 * Calculate start and end dates based on duration.
 * Use this when your data provider API requires explicit start_date and end_date
 * instead of a duration hint or fixed row count.
 *
 * @param duration - Duration string: "1D", "5D", "15D", "1M", "3M", "6M", "1Y", "5Y", "All"
 * @returns Object with start_date, end_date (timestamps in ms), and recommended interval
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { getDateRangeForDuration } from "@gocharting/chart-sdk";
 *
 * const { start_date, end_date, interval } = getDateRangeForDuration("1D");
 * // start_date: 1 day ago in ms
 * // end_date: now in ms
 * // interval: "1m"
 *
 * // Use with your datafeed API:
 * const bars = await fetchBars(symbol, interval, start_date, end_date);
 * ```
 */
export function getDateRangeForDuration(
	duration: DurationString,
): DateRangeResult;

// ============================================================================
// SDK Namespace Type (for window.GoChartingSDK)
// ============================================================================

/**
 * GoCharting SDK namespace type
 * Available on window.GoChartingSDK after SDK is loaded
 */
export type GoChartingSDKNamespace = {
	/**
	 * Create a chart instance
	 * @returns ChartWrapper - Wrapper object with lifecycle management methods
	 */
	createChart(
		container: HTMLElement | string,
		config: ChartConfig,
	): ChartWrapper;

	/**
	 * Calculate start and end dates based on duration
	 * @param duration - Duration string: "1D", "5D", "15D", "1M", "3M", "6M", "1Y", "5Y", "All"
	 * @returns Object with start_date, end_date (timestamps in ms), and recommended interval
	 */
	getDateRangeForDuration(duration: DurationString): DateRangeResult;

	/** Professional Chart React component */
	ProfessionalChart: React.ComponentType<ChartConfig>;

	/** React instance used by SDK */
	React: typeof React;

	/** ReactDOM instance used by SDK */
	ReactDOM: typeof ReactDOM;

	/** SDK version */
	version: string;
};

/**
 * Global window augmentation for GoChartingSDK
 */
declare global {
	interface Window {
		GoChartingSDK: GoChartingSDKNamespace;
	}
}
